objective: Find the smallest audited whole-tooth cohort that improves external dental anatomy without crown, root, family, validity, or repeatability regression.

minimumSufficientCohortRule.selection: Choose the smallest cohort whose pre-registered candidate passes every gate on two independent training seeds; larger cohorts are confirmatory and cannot rescue a failed smaller result retrospectively.
minimumSufficientCohortRule.primaryImprovement: median paired symmetric Chamfer improves by at least 5 percent in the spike and its 95 percent stratified-bootstrap interval excludes zero
nonRegression: HD95 and F-score at 2 percent not worse
no tooth-family median regression greater than 2 percent
root-region surface distance and crown-root proportion not worse
root count and apex completeness not worse
fixed-seed repeatability no greater than 0.25 percent diagonal

productionPolicy: No candidate is promoted automatically. Production remains unchanged until the final benchmark, educator review, endpoint smoke test, rollback receipt, and explicit approval pass.
